### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 6cd13379e216a426f1e85ef0999aef67d3042a09
* **Affected:** /dso:preplanning, dso:story-decomposer
* **Parent bug:** 6e17-7424-68cc-48f8 (Gap A cherry-pick)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker (story-decomposer ships stories whose cross-skill signals diverge from consumers)

#### Expected Behavior

When dso:story-decomposer drafts an epic where ≥2 stories communicate via a non-structured signal (tag string, title prefix, status token, file-path convention), the decomposer MUST surface a constants-doc story as an explicit Done Definition. The story body requires: 'A one-paragraph constants doc exists at plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<signal>.md; producer File Impact AND every consumer File Impact reference it.'

#### Actual Behavior

story-decomposer.md has no detector for cross-story non-structured signals. preplanning's red-team pass does not enforce a constants-doc story when this pattern is present. On epic f360-3a5b-b8f3-4f86, the producer (story-decomposer output) emitted tag 'copy-story' / title 'Apply gov-copy to ...' while the consumer (/dso:sprint Phase E) detected tag 'copy:needed' / title 'Generate UI copy' — pure string drift, caught only post-merge by manual grep.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md — add cross-skill signal detector
* plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md — add constants-doc-required gate in red-team / SC-coverage pass

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] story-decomposer detects ≥2 stories sharing a non-structured signal (tag, title prefix, status token, file-path convention) during decomposition.
- [ ] When detected, a constants-doc story is added to the output with DD referencing plugins/dso/docs/contracts/<signal>.md.
- [ ] Test fixture: an epic that previously produced the f360-3a5b defects now causes the gate to fire (story emitted; DD present).
data.title: [preplanning/story-decomposer]: epic with 2+ stories sharing non-structured cross-skill signal -> no constants-doc artifact required, integration breaks silently
